GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Four Wide 5th 4 Lengths 600m 3 Wide 5th 5 Lengths Straightened Up 5th Middle Of Track no run on Straight # wide/tired late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Inclined to lay in when racing wide and without cover early and middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok Settled Down Mid Field 4 lengths. moved up 3 Wide turn 2 lengths. ran on strongly # just too strong

Jumped Ok , sat 3 Wide No Cover Just off speed 2 Lengths 600m, despite covering extra ground loomed to win at 200m when took over, Just found one better late but held on for gutsy second spot # gutsy effort
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: On jumping bumped with another runner.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Well . Crossed in Settled Down Two Wide 7th about 5 Lengths @ 600m. fanned wider To The Turn . all Clear Straightening Up widest. Gradually Gave Ground . $2.70 Winner Led All The Way # couldn't come on
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Bumped shortly after the start. Raced three wide, without cover, in the middle stages.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped okay & Went Forward to Two Wide Lead by 1 length , went clear and crossed 800m, Held Together in front & led 2 Lengths turning, kept going in Straight # led/bolted in
Just a Bit Slow Out . Settled Down Two Wide at tail 10 Lengths @ 650m. briefly on heels Straightening Up . then Clear and passed a handful coming home # got a long way back
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Steadied when buffeted heavily between runners on jumping. Rounding the home turn was steadied for a number of strides after improving onto heels.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Away well. Pushed fwd & shared lead 3 Wide early . Worked to share lead Two Wide midrace & held ogether =lead 3 Wide on home turn. Pushed to quicken Two Wide @ 300m & hit lead @ 200m. Boxed on until over-run in last 50m. # Worked & faded

Jumped Well , Went Forward 3 Wide No Cover 2 Lengths @ 700m. Kept Coming to 2nd and in Two Wide on home Turn . Equal Lead into Straight . Kept Going Ok but totally swamped the last 20m and fell from 2nd place to 5th. merit in the run though # swamped very late
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Making the first turn near the 800m shifted in and bumped rnr.

GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , enjoyed good trail Two Wide With Cover behind speed 2 Lengths 700m, came Four Wide on the corner and Quickly joined Leaders Straightening Up , drove to the front at the 200m and looked winner, Just found one better last 100m but held brave second spot # one better late
began well to hold the rail then took sit 3len behind leaders every chance # fair run
Jumped Ok , Settled Mid Field rails 5 Lengths 600m, angled back inside from the cutaway and he looked a winning chance at the 200m but he Just peaked late and missed placing # run peaked 100m
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: Near the 700m was eased when tightened for room. At the entrance to the straight became held up on heels and was unable to improve until near the 350m.
